definitions.explanation: Without holding back or being reluctant to give or use something.

examples.japanese: {時間|じかん}を{惜|お}しげもなく{使|つか}う。
{彼|かれ}は{知識|ちしき}を{惜|お}しげもなく{教|おし}えてくれた。
examples.english: He generously shared his knowledge with me.

examples.japanese: {高級食材|こうきゅうしょくざい}を{惜|お}しげもなく{使|つか}った{料理|りょうり}だ。
examples.english: It's a dish made generously with high-quality ingredients.

notes:
CONSTRUCTION:
From {惜|お}しい (regrettable/precious) + げ (appearance suffix) + も + なく (without).

COMMON PATTERNS:
- 〜を{惜|お}しげもなく{使|つか}う: to use ~ generously
- 〜を{惜|お}しげもなく{与|あた}える: to give ~ without holding back
